lead.event: Rupiah reaches successive record lows against the US dollar
lead.headline: Rupiah sets record low at Rp18,319 per US dollar in NDF trading
lead.blurb: The currency also touched Rp18,281/US$ shortly after the spot market opened on 20 November, with reports putting its close at Rp18,268 and Rp18,270. JISDOR closed at Rp18,278, down 0.5% on the day. Analyst Ibrahim Assuaibi expected the rupiah to remain under pressure in the Rp18,270-Rp18,320/US$ range the following week.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The rupiah reached Rp18,319/US$ in NDF trading at 23:39 WIB before Friday, 20 November 2026.

deals_control.event: Adaro Strategic Investments divests its stakes in ADRO and AADI
deals_control.headline: Adaro Strategic Investments divests ADRO and AADI stakes for about Rp66.81 trillion
deals_control.blurb: On 10 November, Adaro Strategic Investments transferred 14.04 billion ADRO shares at Rp2,413 each and 3.2 billion AADI shares at Rp10,286 each to Triputra, Saratoga, Persada Capital and Trinugraha Thohir. Both companies say the transfers simplify their shareholding structures, with no change of control or impact on operations or financial condition.

deals_control.event: PT Sinergi Graha Kapital sells its WIFI stake to the controlling shareholder
deals_control.headline: WIFI controller buys Sinergi Graha Kapital’s 26.67% stake
deals_control.blurb: Solusi Sinergi Digital’s controlling shareholder, Investasi Sukses Bersama, acquired the entire stake on 19 November. It now holds 2.88 billion shares, or 54.42%, while Sinergi Graha Kapital holds none.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

deals_control.event: AKR acquires BP Global's remaining stake in Aneka Petroindo Raya
deals_control.headline: AKRA acquires BP Global’s remaining 49.9% stake in APR for US$14.22 million
deals_control.blurb: AKR acquired 11,444,565 shares from BP Global Investments Limited, raising its ownership from 50.1% to 100% effective 6 November. APR will continue under the BP brand and its existing brand licence agreement.

deals_control.event: Dharma Polimetal partners with Minth Group on EV components
deals_control.headline: DRMA partners Minth Group on EV components through Rp180 billion JV
deals_control.blurb: Dharma Polimetal established the joint venture in September 2026 to supply EV components, particularly aluminium extrusion for chassis and body structures. The project is part of the company's Rp400 billion capital expenditure plan for 2026.

market_structure_policy.event: Indonesia introduces a severance reserve fund rule
market_structure_policy.headline: Indonesia introduces severance reserve fund rule due by 28 October 2027
market_structure_policy.blurb: The requirement under Law No. 27 of 2026 shifts severance from a liability paid at termination to funds set aside in advance. Gajah Tunggal had Rp1.86 trillion in post-employment benefit liabilities in June 2026, while Pan Brothers had 23,762 employees and US$7.63 million in cash.

market_structure_policy.event: Indonesia launches the B50 mandate as Pertamina Patra Niaga completes first lifts
market_structure_policy.headline: Indonesia launches B50 mandate with a 50% palm-based biodiesel blend
market_structure_policy.blurb: Pertamina Patra Niaga completed two initial lifts: 4,600 kiloliters from Kasim on 18 July and 8,230 kiloliters from Plaju on 22 July. The fuel is destined for stations across western and eastern Indonesia.

other.event: BCA declares its fourth-quarter interim dividend of Rp35 per share
other.headline: BBCA declares fourth-quarter interim dividend of Rp35 per share
other.blurb: BCA’s 2026 interim dividends total Rp80 per share, up 45.5% year on year, including the latest Rp35 payout. Shares go ex-dividend in the regular and negotiation markets on 30 November, with payment scheduled for 16 December.

other.event: PKPK subsidiary secures a US$76 million coal sales contract
other.headline: PKPK subsidiary signs US$76 million coal sales contract
other.blurb: Paragon Karya Perkasa shares stood at Rp6,700, up more than 1,000% over the past year. Its subsidiary Tri Oetama Persada signed with Xiangyu Trading Indonesia, also known as Xiamen Xiangyu, for 1 million metric tons at an estimated US$76 per metric ton. Deliveries run from November 2026 to December 2027.

other.event: Adhi Karya faces a PKPU petition from two creditors
other.headline: ADHI faces PKPU petition from two creditors
other.blurb: Adhi Karya says Atap Perkasa and Satek Aire Indonesia filed the petition on 17 November. Its 30 September liabilities were Rp23.46 trillion against assets of Rp26.77 trillion. It has not received official court notice and will verify the petition on receipt, saying it expects no significant impact on operations or finances.

earnings_guidance.event: Merdeka Copper Gold swings to nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: MDKA swings to US$157 million nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Merdeka Copper Gold’s revenue rose 76% year on year to US$2.26 billion. Nickel subsidiary MBMA posted record third-quarter revenue of US$732 million and net profit of US$92 million, while cumulative gold production rose 54% to 116,955 ounces.

earnings_guidance.event: Astrindo reports nine-month results and maintains its 2026 revenue target
earnings_guidance.headline: BIPI keeps its approximately US$140 million 2026 target as nine-month revenue falls 34.23%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Astrindo's PSEL Cipeucang project is planned to handle about 1,100 tons of waste per day and roughly 25 MW of capacity. January-September revenue was US$128.13 million, while net profit of US$5.51 million reversed a US$5.41 million loss.

earnings_guidance.headline: JPMorgan downgrades BBCA to Underweight after 15% gain in 15 days
earnings_guidance.blurb: JPMorgan cited uncertainty over foreign fund flows, noting BCA accounts for around 31% of MSCI Indonesia while its MSCI emerging-market weight fell from 0.5% to 0.15%. The bank advised investors to trim positions after the rally from the shares’ lowest point.

earnings_guidance.event: Telkom’s InfraNexia reports third-quarter revenue and profit
earnings_guidance.headline: TLKM’s InfraNexia reports Q3 revenue of Rp10.5 trillion, profit of Rp1.04 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: InfraNexia recorded the figures through Q3 2026, with external TelkomGroup customer revenue up 22.1% year on year to Rp1.42 trillion. A second-stage transfer of Telkom’s wholesale fiber connectivity business and assets, valued at Rp49.86 trillion, took effect on 1 October 2026 after the first stage began on 1 January.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: XLSMART prepares a Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EXCL prepares Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The three-month program runs from 23 November to 22 February 2027 and will use internal cash; the number of shares depends on execution prices and regulatory limits. XLSMART expects pro forma basic EPS to move from minus Rp88 to minus Rp90 per share.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Semen Indonesia allocates Rp250 billion for a share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: SMGR plans share buyback of up to Rp250 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Semen Indonesia expects to conduct the buyback over three months from 20 November using internal funds, with repurchased shares capped at 20% of issued and paid-up capital. In a simulation based on 30 June figures, earnings per share would rise from Rp34 to Rp35 while net profit remains Rp207.01 billion.

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PRDA completes 2026 buyback of 36.14 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Prodia repurchased the shares for Rp112.42 billion, including transaction costs, at an average Rp3,033 each during a program that ran from 20 August to 19 November. Its treasury holdings now total 83.86 million shares, or 8.95% of paid-up capital, below the 20% maximum.
